title: INT8 field validation and canary orchestration for GPTQ/AWQ profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: integrate INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) into the nightly calibration and canary pipeline with deterministic field validation against production-like prompts. We want systematic checks for accuracy regressions, numerical drift across hardware (A100/RTX6000/H100), and early rollback triggers for canary traffic. This ticket wires up profile ingestion, telemetry checks, and operator-visible signals for rollout decisions.
scope: Add profile ingestion hook for new INT8 profile artifacts (metadata + calibration matrix)
Extend nightly calibration harness to run INT8 profiles on canonical prompt sets (short/long, chain-of-thought, safety-sensitive)
Create lightweight hardware smoke tests to compare FP32 baseline vs INT8 outputs and token-level perplexity deltas
Define canary orchestration rules: threshold-based fail/rollback, sample size, and fallback model mapping
Expose per-profile metrics in Console: token-level accuracy delta, latency delta, and quantization hit-rate
acceptance_criteria: Nightly job picks up new INT8 profiles and completes calibration run within existing nightly window
For each profile, the harness produces a standardized report (JSON) with numeric deltas and a pass/fail decision
Canary pipeline will route 1% of traffic to configured INT8 profile and automatically rollback at configured thresholds
Console shows per-profile QA metrics and a link to discrepancy diffs (textual and token-aligned)
Hardware smoke tests run on A100 and H100 images and produce consistent pass/fail within tolerance defined in the profile metadata
tasks: Define INT8 profile JSON schema extension for calibration metadata (author, matrix, tolerances)
Implement ingestion service that validates and stores profile artifacts to S3 + metadata DB
Update nightly calibration pipeline to execute GPTQ and AWQ-backed quantized evaluation jobs
Add diff tooling to produce human-readable token alignment and top-k logprobs comparison
Implement canary routing rules and rollback hooks in smart-router (with test harness)
Instrument Console to surface metrics and attach the latest profile report to model page
Add unit/integration tests and a smoke job for A100/H100/RTX to CI matrix
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: INT8 outputs may diverge more on chain-of-thought prompts — Mitigation: include dedicated chain-of-thought prompt subset and tighten thresholds there
Risk: Hardware variance between vendors causes flaky pass/fail — Mitigation: use relative delta thresholds and require multi-hardware agreement before gating rollout
Risk: Nightly window grows due to expensive evals — Mitigation: sample stratified subsets and enable parallelization across worker pool
Risk: False positives triggering rollback — Mitigation: require sustained threshold breaches across two consecutive runs or confirm in manual review channel
